summary: Completed E2E testing of Circle Invites flow for Reassura app. All 7 features tested and verified working correctly. Full flow tested: /circles → click 'Family' → click + button → fill name → click Send Invite → see confirmation with 'Invite sent!' → click 'Back to Circle' → verify PENDING INVITES section with invitee name and Pending badge.
critical_code_review_comments: InviteContext implementation is clean - stores invites in React state with addInvite and getInvitesForCircle functions
Invite form (circle-invite.tsx) properly uses useTheme() tokens for all UI elements (background, borders, inputs)
Send Invite button correctly shows disabled state (theme.border/greyed) when name is empty, enabled state (theme.sage/green) when filled
Confirmation screen shows proper message with invitee name and 'Back to Circle' button with testID='invite-done-button'
PENDING INVITES section correctly appears in circles.tsx after sending invite, shows invitee name with Pending badge
test_credentials: No credentials needed - bypass onboarding via localStorage.setItem('reassura_onboarding_v2', 'true')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Circle Invites feature fully implemented. Key testIDs: invite-circle-button (+ button in header), invite-name-input, invite-contact-input, send-invite-button, invite-done-button, invite-back-button. Flow: /circles → click 'Family' text → click invite-circle-button → fill form → click send-invite-button → see confirmation → click invite-done-button → back to circle with PENDING INVITES section. Invite data is MOCKED (stored in InviteContext React state, no backend call).

features_verified.invite_button_in_header: PASS - + button (invite-circle-button) visible in Circles screen header
features_verified.invite_form_elements: PASS - Shows 'Invite to Family' header, name input (invite-name-input), contact input (invite-contact-input), Send Invite button (send-invite-button)
features_verified.send_button_disabled_state: PASS - Button is disabled/greyed (backgroundColor: rgba(61, 46, 34, 0.09), pointerEvents: none) when name is empty
features_verified.send_button_enabled_state: PASS - Button becomes green/enabled (backgroundColor: rgb(122, 158, 135)) when name is filled
features_verified.confirmation_screen: PASS - Shows 'Invite sent!' heading, invitee name message, 'Back to Circle' button (invite-done-button)
features_verified.pending_invites_section: PASS - After going back, PENDING INVITES section appears with invitee name ('Auntie Bev'), envelope emoji, 'Pending' badge

mocked_data.invite_sending: MOCKED - No real backend call, invites stored in InviteContext React state via addInvite function
